skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to understand and use relevant vocabulary related to real estate.
Students will be able to analyze real estate markets using English language tools.
Students will be able to perform property valuations in English.
Students will be able to conduct real estate brokerage operations in English.
Students will be able to manage real estate properties in English.
Students will be able to handle real estate finance and investment in English.
Students will be able to communicate effectively in English, both individually and in groups.
Students will be able to think critically about real estate issues in English.
